intro.title: Finding My Values and Direction
intro.question: Even in anxiety, what direction do you want to go?
description: So you don't lose your way in the waves, find the direction you truly want to move toward.
Values are not a destination to reach, but a lighthouse that illuminates the path.
Take a moment to see if your direction points toward that light, and take a small step forward.
intro.contentDescription: Discover your values and plan concrete actions that align with that direction.
steps: 1. Mark your current position on the 4-domain target.
2. Define the 'value' for the area furthest from the center.
3. Identify the obstacles blocking your way.
4. Set a small committed action you're willing to take, even with those obstacles.
intro.tip: Tip: A value isn't a 'goal' to achieve—it's a constant direction of who you want to be as an ocean.

step1.title: How close are your actions to your values?
step1.description: Tap all 4 areas to mark your position. The closer to the center (Bull's Eye), the more you're living in line with your values.

step2.title: Who do you want to be in this area?
step2.description: These are the areas furthest from the center. If there were no obstacles, what kind of person (value) would you want to be here?
step2.placeholder: e.g., Someone who pauses and reflects for growth

step3.title: What obstacles are holding you back?
step3.description: Write down the thoughts, feelings, or situations that block you from living toward your values.
step3.placeholder: e.g., Anxiety about falling behind, the pressure to be perfect

step4.title: A small step to move 1cm closer to the center
step4.description: Set a very small, specific action you can take for your values, even when obstacles appear.
step4.placeholder: e.g., Gently reflecting on my day for 5 minutes

result.title: You've found your values and direction
description: A lighthouse now shines over your deepened ocean.
Even if rough waves shake you, your current can flow steadily toward that light.
The small ripples you created today will eventually complete the vast ocean you dream of.
